messages.subject: (r)stan slow with model generating data
parts:
Hi!

I am using Stan to perform some simulations via the generated quantities block. I noticed that there is a severe performance hit if the output I request gets large. Attached is a minimal example which exemplifies the problem.

I am not sure if the issue is on the stan or rstan side. In any case, the more data I let stan generate, the longer the startup of Stan and the longer it takes to return the data to R. Of course, more data takes longer, but from watch the example yourself.

To give you a rough number: It takes more than 4 minutes to get 1e6 samples from a normal 0,1 from stan (the model is pre-compiled).

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] (r)stan slow with model generating data
parts:
It's not going to be on the Stan C++ side because Stan just
iterates the sample independently in a streaming fashion (it's
implemented like an iterator underneath) and has no idea how
many draws it's going to be asked to make ahead of time.

If you're just simulating, you should turn off warmup if you
haven't already.

- Bob
